title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Whimsicott Wild Force 008/071 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon card features the beloved character Whimsicott from the Wild Force set. With a beautiful holo finish, this card is sure to be a showpiece in any collection. It is a Stage 2 Pokémon card with the card number 008/071 and is manufactured by Nintendo.

The card is in excellent shape and has been well-maintained, ready for your collection. It is a perfect addition to any Pokémon TCG enthusiast's collection. Don't miss out on the chance to own this rare card from Japan.
